messages:
nina.ops: quick note: quota dashboard alerted on sudden drop in per-tenant cost per-token for tenant-beta around 04:20 UTC
paul.metrics: digging into traces now, seems like policy router returned `fallback: true` for many small requests. console shows those were mapped to the low-cost quantized model.
paul.metrics: suspect a misapplied routing policy rule after the recent policy DSL tweak (policy v3.5)
oliver.sdk: recent TS SDK added route fallback hints when connectivity to dedicated pool is flaky. maybe it's auto-applying fallback hints incorrectly
ci-bot: policy-deploy 3402 completed :white_check_mark:
sara.prod: rolling logs show header `x-fallback-hint: model-quantized` set by edge proxy on some reconnects
nina.ops: edge proxy change merged last week might be aggressive about retry+fallback header injection
oliver.sdk: we intentionally added aggressive fallback in 1.8.2 to reduce latency for flaky pods, but it should only apply on retry, not initial request. open PR: https://github.com/redwoodinc/ts-sdk/pull/777
paul.metrics: can we add a guard in console to ignore `x-fallback-hint` when request flag `initial=true` present? do SDKs even set that flag?
oliver.sdk: we don't set `initial` flag in client. we rely on proxy to annotate retries. seems mismatch
ci-bot: rollout 3402-post started for proxy change :rocket:
sara.prod: temporary mitigation: adding routing rule to prefer model ARN over any fallback hints for first-request traffic for 10m window
paul.metrics: I'll run a compare of token cost before/after the routing guard and report
nina.ops: remind: need a postmortem entry to tighten integration contract between SDKs and proxy about who annotates retries/fallbacks; these are crossing layers and causing surprising billing outcomes
oliver.sdk: adding tests to TS SDK to ensure fallback hints only attach on retry attempts and to add explicit opt-in flag for aggressive fallback behavior
paul.metrics: metrics-after-guard show costs back to baseline. will monitor for 1h and then consider moving to staged rollout instead of immediate revert
ci-bot: canary revert for proxy change initiated :white_check_mark:
sara.prod: will follow up with automated runbook to toggle routing preference if similar anomalies occur
nina.ops: thanks team. action items: oliver -> ts-sdk PR update + opt-in flag; paul -> cost regression check + dashboard rule; nina -> postmortem doc stub; sara -> update runbooks
